title: aVolClusterPOI as cluster-mass anomaly, not a cell and not a trade
object: A contiguous hot-price cluster whose summed volume is extreme versus the same session-relative time bucket in prior complete sessions.
why_now: F2.7–F2.10 closed BigTrap2-as-magnet. aVol is the next independent family. Cluster mass is a different question than a single hot tick.

research_defaults.note: v0.4 exploration used percentile 95 and min_samples 5. That lets a handful of blocks set the threshold. Research defaults ask ~20 prior block scores in the same bucket before detecting.

nt8_overlay: Direction, QualityScore, burst, target/stop may remain visual in the .cs. They must not create, drop, or rank zones in the research kernel.
first_success: Python kernel matches the declared cluster/quantile/no-lookahead contract on fixtures. Not a chart that looks busy.
